The chart has two places that consume `FHIRResource`, and the vitals app is the more exposed one.

1. **Vitals app, `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/data.resource.ts`**
   - `extractEncounterUuid` (lines 561-566) reads `FHIRResource['resource']['encounter']` and splits `encounter.reference` on `/` to get the encounter UUID. A change to the `resource.encounter` shape or reference format would break vitals-to-encounter mapping.
   - `useVitalsAndBiometrics` (lines 226-246) pages through results with `useSWRInfinite`, typed with `FHIRSearchBundleResponse`. Paging depends on the bundle shape those entries come in.
   - I did not read the rest of the file (after line 249), where the entries are mapped into vitals rows. That is the most likely place for a behaviour change to bite, so it needs a check.

2. **Vitals app types, `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/types.ts`** (lines 1-8)
   - `FHIRSearchBundleResponse` wraps `Array<FHIRResource>` in `entry`. Every vitals fetch that uses this type inherits any change to the entry type.

3. **Form entry app, `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-form-entry-app/src/app/form-data-source/form-data-source.service.ts`** (lines 220-239)
   - The `Observation/$lastn` call types its response as `{ entry: Array<FHIRResource> }`. The `reduce` reads `entry.resource.resourceType`, `entry.resource.code.coding`, `valueString` and related fields to build an encounter-like `obs` object for the historical data source. Changes to those fields would change the output.

4. **Form entry mock, `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-form-entry-app/src/openmrs-esm-framework.mock.ts`** (line 41)
   - This declares its own local `FHIRResource` interface. It is a test mock, so a framework change does not flow into it automatically. It can drift from the real type, and I did not check whether it is used in tests.

The framework definition is in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-emr-api/src/types/fhir-resource.ts` (lines 1-32). Its shape is what the chart code depends on: `resource.encounter`, `resource.code.coding`, `resource.valueString`, `resource.resourceType`, and `resource.subject`. The `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/interfaces/FHIRResource.md` page is generated documentation for the same type.

Limits: all `FHIRResource` references in the chart were found by symbol search and a regex grep, which both returned the same 8 matches. I did not search the other repositories for copies of the type, and I did not check whether the framework exports it under other names.
